usage: cox chair ask [-h] [--option OPTION] [--context CONTEXT] [--label LABEL]
                     [--profile PROFILE]
                     question

positional arguments:
  question

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --option OPTION    an answer pat may give; repeat for each, at least two
  --context CONTEXT  text or a URL that helps pat decide
  --label LABEL      the chair's label (default: $COX_SESSION_LABEL, else unlabeled)
  --profile PROFILE
